2. Destructure `schedule` from results

- Change `Promise.all([loadStats(), loadLog()])` to `Promise.all([loadStats(), loadLog(), loadWaketimeSchedule()])`
- Change `.then(function ([stats, log]) {` to `.then(function ([stats, log, schedule]) {`
- Replace:
```
        const nextWake = new Date(stats.last_wake);
        nextWake.setMinutes(nextWake.getMinutes() + 90);
```
with:
```
        let nextWake;
        if (schedule && schedule.length > 0) {
          const upcoming = schedule
            .filter(function (t) {
              const d = new Date(t.runAt);
              return d > new Date();
            })
            .slice(0, 1);
          if (upcoming.length > 0) {
            nextWake = new Date(upcoming[0].runAt);
          } else {
            nextWake = new Date(stats.last_wake);
            nextWake.setMinutes(nextWake.getMinutes() + 90);
          }
        } else {
          nextWake = new Date(stats.last_wake);
          nextWake.setMinutes(nextWake.getMinutes() + 90);
        }
```
